name: Underhive Rat
summary: Underhive Rat; Gain expertise in Stealth or Sleight of Hand. You have advantage on checks to hide in urban ruins, crowds, vents, pipes, and debris.  Underhive Rat; Climbing, crawling, squeezing, and moving through tight spaces costs you no extra movement.  Underhive Rat; Once per short rest, when an attack misses you while you are in cover, you may Hide as a reaction.  Underhive Rat; When you Hide as a reaction, you may also move 5 ft.
descriptionMarkdown:
Underhive Rat; Gain expertise in Stealth or Sleight of Hand. You have advantage on checks to hide in urban ruins, crowds, vents, pipes, and debris.

Underhive Rat; Climbing, crawling, squeezing, and moving through tight spaces costs you no extra movement.

Underhive Rat; Once per short rest, when an attack misses you while you are in cover, you may Hide as a reaction.

Underhive Rat; When you Hide as a reaction, you may also move 5 ft.
